shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- files ---'; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '%s\\n' '--- package ---'; cat package.json; printf '%s\\n' '--- next docs candidates ---'; rg -l \"middleware|proxy|request\" node_modules/next/dist/docs --glob '*.md' | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/16-proxy.md; printf '\\n--- API reference candidates ---\\n'; rg -l \"export function proxy|matcher.*proxy|proxy.ts\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference --glob '*.md' | sed -n '1,40p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: proxy.ts
+import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
+
+export function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
+  console.log(
+    "'`[request] ${request.method} ${request.nextUrl.pathname}${request.nextUrl.search}`,
+  )
+
+  return NextResponse.next()
+}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- proxy.ts tsconfig.json; printf '\\n--- status ---\\n'; git status --short; printf '\\n--- numbered proxy ---\\n'; nl -ba proxy.ts; printf '\\n--- numbered tsconfig ---\\n'; nl -ba tsconfig.json | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-      \"@/*\": [
-        \"./*\"
-      ]
+      \"@/*\": [\"./*\"]
     }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",
-    \"**/*.ts\",
-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git diff --check
git status --short"
